learning_outcomes.text: Students know common driving tests for the subjective and objective description of vehicle properties.
They are able to select, plan, prepare, and independently conduct suitable tests to characterize vehicle behavior and the behavior of individual components.
Recorded measurement data can be processed and evaluated.
The results can be analyzed and improvement measures derived.
They are able to write meaningful test reports and establish connections to the contents of the Vehicle Technology lecture.

syllabus_topics: Test planning based on standardized driving maneuvers according to DIN/ISO
Developing individual test constellations based on specific questions
Vehicle preparation and equipping vehicles with suitable measurement technology
Verification of sensor data before the start of the test
Conducting driving tests on suitable proving grounds
Processing of measurement data also with regard to vehicle coordinate systems according to ISO 8855
Standard-compliant evaluation of measurement data and test documentation
Assessment of vehicle properties using objective and subjective methods
teaching_methods: Component tests with high practical presence in the vehicle lab and on proving grounds
assessment_rules: The type of examination will be determined at the beginning of the semester. To receive credit points, students must pass the module examination, actively participate in the tests, and successfully complete excursions. The grade's weighting for the final grade is based on credit points.
